events.title: Voyager @ Books, Babies, & Brews
events.description: Join us for a Baby Storytime led by Franklin County Library, sensory exploration & coffee with Franklin County Parks and Recreation, and health education & resources provided by FCHD RIMC Program! This event is rain or shine, every Friday from Sept-Nov at 10:00 a.m., featuring different County Parks each month. It is designed for newborns to cruisers with an in-the-lap 15-minute Storytime and sensory toys appealing to younger babies. Storytime will start a few minutes after 10:00 a.m. and the rest of the hour is for free play, socializing, and taking advantage of the Bookmobile, Voyager!    September-Franklinton Park  October-Epsom Park  November-V.E. and Lydia H. Owens Recreational Park at Bull Creek https://www.franklincountync.gov/calendar.aspx?EID=2611
events.venue: Owens Park - 499 Massenburg Baker Road  Louisburg NC 27549

events.title: Louisburg - Fiber Arts Group
events.description: Gather your yarn, threads, and current projects for a morning of creativity and community at our Fiber Arts Meetup! Whether you knit, crochet, embroider, or work with any other textiles, bring your own work-in-progress to craft alongside fellow makers of all skill levels. It is a space to share ideas, swap tips, and enjoy dedicated crafting time together. Meets every second Thursday at the library in Louisburg.  https://www.franklincountync.gov/calendar.aspx?EID=2635
events.venue: Central Library
